PLATFORM

AI proposes. Rules check. Experts decide.

Every step leaves evidence. No case is excluded by AI alone until its measured accuracy on your data meets a threshold your qualified person has approved.

THE PRINCIPLE

Nothing is dropped on a model’s say-so.

An agent can propose that an item is not a valid case. It cannot act on that alone. Until the measured accuracy for that decision, on your data, clears a threshold your qualified person has signed off, every exclusion goes to a person. The threshold is yours to set, and it is written down.

  • Measured firstAccuracy is measured on your own historical data before anything runs unattended.
  • Approved by your QPYour qualified person approves the threshold for each decision type, in writing.
  • ReversibleIf measured accuracy drops below the threshold, the decision returns to people automatically.
ARCHITECTURE

Five stages, one evidence trail.

The same pipeline runs behind every product. Blue is an agent proposing; amber is a person deciding.

  1. Ingest
  2. Understand
  3. Check
  4. Decide
  5. Deliver
ON A FOUNDATION OF
  • EvaluationGold sets gate every change
  • Audit trailTime-stamped and attributable
  • Model gatewayOne controlled interface
  • Tenant isolationSeparate, encrypted per customer
WHAT WE MEASURE

The numbers we report back.

These are the measures themselves, not results. Each one is measured on your own data in every pilot and reported to you, whatever it says.

  • Recall

    Of the valid cases present in a period, the share the system found.

    MEASURED IN EVERY PILOT
  • False negatives per 1,000 items

    How many valid cases were missed, at a rate you can compare across periods.

    MEASURED IN EVERY PILOT
  • Precision

    Of the items flagged for review, the share that turned out to be valid.

    MEASURED IN EVERY PILOT
  • Extraction completeness

    The share of mandatory fields filled correctly from the source, without a person retyping them.

    MEASURED IN EVERY PILOT
  • Reviewer minutes per item

    How long a qualified reviewer actually spends on an item, start to decision.

    MEASURED IN EVERY PILOT
  • On-time rate

    The share of regulatory submissions made inside the reporting clock.

    MEASURED IN EVERY PILOT
EVALUATIONEvery change passes a gate.

Model, prompt and rule changes run against gold sets before they reach your data. A change that moves recall the wrong way does not ship.

AUDIT TRAIL

Every decision, reconstructable.

Each decision records what proposed it, which versions were running, the exact words it came from, who decided, and when. An inspector can replay any case.

SECURITY AND DATA

Where your data lives, and what touches it.

  • Hosted in India

    Your data is processed and stored in Indian regions, under the DPDP Act.

  • Encrypted in transit and at rest

    Standard transport encryption, and encryption at rest for every store.

  • Isolated per customer

    Each customer’s data sits in its own isolated tenant. Nothing is pooled.

  • No training on your data

    We do not train models on your data. If we ever propose to, it needs your written consent first, per product.

  • Zero-retention model providers

    Model providers are used under zero-retention terms, so prompts and outputs are not kept or trained on by them.

  • Access is logged

    Who looked at what, and when, is recorded with the same audit trail as every other action.
